correctness.rationale: Anchored-to-minimum coordinate changes are unimodular. The range decomposition distinguishes spread≤1 contributing N from spread>1 with same-part extrema and independent coordinate intervals of lengths r and 2−r, giving the exact integral. A beta-binomial identity gives the t=2 expression. Its size-dependent integral has strictly positive second discrete differences, proving global strict majorization by unit transfers. Dominated convergence, the binomial CLT/Stirling and a fixed-k upper tail prove the stated three asymptotic regimes. Exact independent Ehrhart enumeration confirms 10 small rational-volume configurations; 492 endpoint formulas and 2230 majorization pairs pass. Finite computation is not presented as universal proof.

A strict Schur-convex volume law over every multipartition at fixed order gives a natural complete extremal classification rather than a selected example; sharp linear, N^(3/2), and exponential endpoint regimes identify mathematically meaningful geometric differences.
